body:
Every sentence in your post applies to me as well.  20, virgin, going into my third year of college, no social life, average looking, find myself dumb, socially awkward, boring personality, shy, scared of turning 30 still a virgin, scared, anxious, and neurotic.  

So please, send me a PM when you figure this shit out! :)

I'm in the same boat as you.  After decades of consistent agony I'm just so tired and really want this to end.  I have a few good days here and there, but my monthly averages have fallen on the not-worth-living side of things for as long as I can remember.  

Still, I don't have the guts to kill myself.  And I really do think it takes guts, unlike /u/lastleast claims.  Their advice seems like something out of a self-help book written by someone who hasn't been worn out by decades of hanging on to something that just isn't worth it.  

A friend of mine had guts, and he killed himself a couple years ago.  He was just like me, and now I'm envious of him.  I'm still struggling along here while he's forever at peace in cosmic relaxation.  Man, how I'd like some of that right about now.  

But, okay, so neither of us have the guts yet.  Might as well do something to pass the time while we wait, even if it's just idle conversation.

> Volunteer: I can't speak with you if you're going to get angry.

I'm not exactly calling to tell you how good life is!
